observations: Photo 0: A rectangular metal mold plate with two bottle-shaped cavities machined into it, showing a diamond-textured body design; faint mirrored embossed text reading something like 'CALVAIRE' is visible inside the cavity.

Photo 1: Same mold plate, with a real Pepsi-branded plastic bottle laid next to one cavity, apparently to show a size/shape comparison; the Pepsi bottle itself is not part of the mold, just a reference object.

Photo 2: The same or a similar 2-cavity mold mounted inside what appears to be a blow-molding machine, with two bottles (appearing dark/smoky, possibly mid-process or just removed) seated in the mold interface.
No brand plate, model number, or manufacturer marking is visible on the mold body itself in any photo.
No full machine (oven, stretch rods, control panel) is shown — only the mold block and its mounting interface in photo 2.

identity.kind: 2-cavity PET bottle blow mold (for blow molding machine)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 both show two cavities in the mold block.

claims.claim: Available in different designs and sizes
claims.evidence: No other designs or sizes are shown in the photos; this is a text claim about stock not pictured.

risks.risk: Condition and wear of the cavity surface (scratches, pitting) which affects bottle finish quality
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photos of the cavity interior walls and parting line edges

risks.risk: Neck finish size and thread compatibility (e.g., 28mm PCO, 30mm) with buyer's existing machine
risks.proof: Close-up photo or caliper measurement of the neck/finish area with dimensions labeled
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/incompatible, requiring buyer verification

risks.risk: Whether mold is complete and functional (no cracks, all pins/guides present, cooling channels intact)
risks.proof: Video of the mold actually producing a bottle on a working machine
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / functionality unverified

risks.risk: Material of construction (aluminum vs. steel) affecting durability and cycle life
risks.proof: Close photo showing material grain/weight, or seller statement with a readable material tag

risks.risk: Whether this 'different designs and sizes' claim includes this exact mold or refers to other stock entirely
risks.proof: Additional listing photos or catalog showing the specific design/size range with this mold included
risks.if_unproven: priced based only on the single design/size shown, ignoring the broader claim

proof_requests: Video of the mold mounted and cycling on a blow molding machine, producing a complete bottle
Close-up measured photo of the neck finish diameter and thread pattern
Close-up photos of the cavity interior for scratches, corrosion, or damage
Photo showing the mold's material tag or a scale/weight reading to confirm aluminum vs steel
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a 2-cavity PET bottle blow mold shown in use and in isolation, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified condition, compatibility, and functionality) even though no brand or model is legible on the tool itself.
